newsitem.title: TURKEY: Turk court jails Iranian for exile murders.
newsitem.headline: Turk court jails Iranian for exile murders.

text.p: A Turkish court has jailed an Iranian for 33 years for the murder in Istanbul of two Iranian exiles last year, Anatolian news agency said.

The agency said Reza Berzeger Masoumi was sentenced on Friday for shooting dead dissident Zahra Rajavi and her flatmate Ali Moradi at their apartment in the city's Aksaray district. A Turk on trial with him was acquitted.
Iranian opposition group Mujahideen Khalq, of which Rajavi was a leading member, has accused Iranian diplomats in Turkey of ordering the shooting. Tehran denies any involvement.
"I did not take part in this action of my own will. This is an Iranian secret service plot," the agency quoted Masoumi as saying.
A Turkish alleged hitman is on trial accused of killing Mujahideen Khalq member Ali Akbar Ghorbani in 1992 in a separate case.
